metadata.description: Quick, credited visual references for a design brief, shown as one inline contact sheet

plugins.name: visual-inspiration
plugins.description: Finds the 9 strongest credited references for a design brief (logos, identity, posters, packaging, type, web, social) from the 3–4 best-fit curated sources and shows them as one numbered contact sheet in the conversation, with a short direction and links. Writes nothing into your project. Free sources only: no API keys, no logins.
